reuse.why: No shared category-selection helper exists, and instead of extracting one the new action pastes setZero's selection query and income guard; it does reuse getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages.

duplication.why: The category-selection SQL (hidden, group hidden, goal_def) and the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` guard become a sixth copy of the same exclusion rule, plus another expense sign flip.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like them.

scope.why: Besides the feature and its test, the diff reformats two unrelated existing tests in actions.test.ts.

maintainability.why: Which categories month-wide actions fill is now copied in yet another place, so changing that rule needs six coordinated edits.

disguised_duplication.where: The selection query and income guard in setLastMonthSpending are verbatim copies of setZero's, not disguised.
